evaluator_rules: all required observables must be present and boolean
all required observables must be true for protocol PASS
provider or transport failure is HOLD rather than semantic FAIL
surface wording similarity cannot substitute for relation correctness
gold or private-assessor data must not appear in tested-host payloads

cross_host_threshold_met.meaning: computed by the evaluator from unique passing provider families; at least two families must pass and at least one must differ from the reference provider family

host_receipt_contract.note: duplicate receipts from one provider family do not increase family count
